Vault dweller |TV actor =[[Adam Faison]] |stunt double=[[Anthony Czumalowski]] }} '''Ronnie McCurtry''' is an employee of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] and resident of [[Vault 31]] in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== Prior to the [[Great War]], Ronnie was a junior Vault-Tec employee working at the [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Vault-Tec headquarters]] in [[Los Angeles]], purportedly the personal assistant of senior junior vice president [[Bud Askins]]. He was one of the employees selected by Askins to participate in his executive assistant training program and Vault experiment "[[Bud's Buds]]." Like most others in the program, Ronnie was a true believer in Bud's cause for establishing Vault-Tec hegemony in the post-apocalypse; Ronnie was particularly callous, bold enough to order around his fellow trainees, and readily willing to kill in Vault-Tec's name.Ronnie McCurtry: ''"He's not one of us. He's been lying to us this entire time."''
[[Clark (TV series)|Clark]]: ''"So, what do we do with him?"''
[[Pete (TV series)|Pete]]: ''"He's dangerous. Untrustworthy."''
Ronnie: ''"Right, right. And if we let him go, he could come back and try and kill us."''
Clark: ''"Yeah."''
Ronnie: ''"Right? Wait, I'm actually pretty sure that the Vault-Tec Handbook says that impersonating management is punishable by death."''
Clark: ''"Oh, well, if you're pretty sure the Vault-Tec Handbook says that, I mean..."''
Pete: ''"And if, you know, if that's protocol."''
Clark: ''"Yeah. Yeah."''
Pete: ''"Right?"''
({{FOTV|2|7}})[[Ronnie McCurtry]]: ''"Don't worry."''
Claudia: ''"Ronnie!"''
Ronnie: ''"We'll give him a fair trial."''
Claudia: ''"Stop! No, don't!"''
Ronnie: ''"This is America, after all."''
Claudia: ''"Stop! What are you gonna do to him?"''
Ronnie: ''"You're not one of us either, Claudia. You only got this job last week."''
({{FOTV|2|8}}) Furthermore, Ronnie was aware of Phase 2 in Bud's experimental program, as he had been assigned to take the lunch orders during a meeting when Bud was discussing these plans with the Vaults' investors. As such, he knew that Phase 2 involved [[Vault 32|Vaults 32]] and [[Vault 33|33]], including something called "Future Enterprise Ventures."[[Ronnie McCurtry|Ronnie]]: ''"Hey, boss. Now that we've found food, it's time for phase two?"''
[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"What is your name?"''
Ronnie: ''"Oh, um, I'm Ronnie. McCurtry."''
Norm MacLean: ''"I decide the next steps up here, Ronnie."''
Ronnie: ''"I know, yeah, you're the-- you're the boss. I know you call the shots. Just thought I'd introduce myself, 'cause I was Bud's personal assistant."''
Norm MacLean: ''"Hm, so?"''
Ronnie: ''"So, uh, let's just say I was the guy who took the lunch orders when Bud was meeting with the Vault investors. 'Future Enterprise Ventures'? The whole plan for Vaults 32 and 33?"''
Norm MacLean: ''"What do you know about that?"''
Ronnie: ''"Like I said, I was just the guy who got the lunch orders, but I do know that Phase 2 was very important to the experiment."''
({{FOTV|2|4}}) However, it is unclear how much he knew beyond these buzzwords, such as the fact that "Future Enterprise Ventures" actually referred to the [[Forced Evolutionary Virus]],{{FOTV|2|5}} or that the "investors" behind Vault-Tec were actually the [[Enclave]].{{FOTV|2|8}} Along with the rest of the Bud's Buds trainees, Ronnie was put into [[cryonics|cryonic suspension]] inside [[Vault 31]] when the Great War occurred. He spent the next 219 years preserved inside the Vault until July 2296, when [[Norm MacLean]] (who had been trapped inside the Vault after investigating) reactivated many of the preserved [[Vault 31 dweller]]s, Ronnie included, in order to escape the Vault. Ronnie nominally went along with Norm's claim that Bud had died and made him the group's new leader due to being a "super manager." However, he was seemingly suspicious of Norm from the very start. Once they had secured food on the surface, Ronnie moved to claim leadership over Norm based on his position as Bud's former assistant and his insider knowledge, leading the group to the former Vault-Tec headquarters where they had worked. While most of the 31ers were seemingly detached from the devastation around them; Ronnie and his two closest confidants, [[Clark (TV series)|Clark]] and [[Pete (TV series)|Pete]], were particularly callous, even making fun of their deceased coworkers. At the Vault-Tec headquarters, Ronnie acted to carry on Bud's plans, intending to contact the "investors" to carry out Phase 2.[[Ronnie McCurtry]]: ''"Alright. Comms Room. Clark, Pete, with me. (switches clicking) It's dead."''
[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"Who were you hoping to contact?"''
Ronnie: ''"The investors. [...] Hey, Clark, you're project manager. Get this operational, stat."''
[[Clark (TV series)|Clark]]: ''"Shouldn't take long."''
Ronnie: ''"Hey, Pete, go try that one."''
({{FOTV|2|5}}) However, after eavesdropping on a conversation between Norm and [[Claudia (TV series)|Claudia]], he soon discovered that Norm was lying to them and had personally killed Bud, causing him to angrily attack and subdue Norm for his deception. Ronnie sought to have Norm killed (pursuant with the Vault-Tec handbook's regulations on impersonating Vault-Tec staff being punishable by death), ignoring Claudia's pleas on the basis that she was not truly one of them either due to having only newly joined the company before the war. However, his attempt to stop Claudia from helping Norm inadvertently caused the entire group to be attacked by [[Radroach (TV series)|radroaches]]; when the group tried to shelter in a break room, Ronnie's refusal to let Norm in ironically protected Norm while dooming the rest of the 31ers. While everyone inside the room is seen to have been killed or maimed by the radroaches apart from Claudia, Ronnie's fate is unclear, as he is not clearly visible inside. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== Ronnie is one of the first dwellers seen as the cryopods in Vault 31 open. Once he wakes up, he starts shivering and rubs his shoulder. He remains seated as many of the other dwellers begin to change into their Vault jumpsuits, and he stays silent while Norm MacLean tells them he is Bud's successor. However, once Norm reveals that Bud is dead and everyone is trapped inside Vault 31, most of the dwellers start panicking, while Ronnie, agitated, asks if there is someone else from management they can speak to. Once Norm regains control over the audience, Ronnie listens to his claim that they must work together to escape the Vault as Bud's final test. When Norm offers "merit dots" (repurposed bandages) as an incentive, Ronnie seems suspicious even though most of the other dwellers perk up at the idea of being rewarded. Eventually, the dwellers figure out a way to escape the Vault by using an exhaust vent to climb up to the surface. Ronnie and the other dwellers follow Norm and emerge into the desertified wasteland of [[Santa Monica]], where they gaze out at the ruins of [[Santa Monica Pier]]. Ronnie's first reaction is that the wasteland is dirty. ===[[The Demon in the Snow]]=== The Vault 31ers have ventured further into the urban ruins of Los Angeles and are seen looting an abandoned [[BlamCo]] delivery truck for food (dry, still-preserved [[BlamCo Mac & Cheese]]). Ronnie interjects while Norm and Claudia are talking, faking friendliness while asking Norm about their next steps. Though Norm tries to enforce his leadership, Ronnie subtly attacks him by revealing that he was Bud's personal assistant before the war. This isn't meaningful to Norm until Ronnie reveals that he sat in on meetings with Vault investors and thus learned about Phase 2, "[[Future Enterprise Ventures]]" (FEV), and the plan for [[Vault 32]] and [[Vault 33]]. Norm is visibly unsettled by this and tries to get more information from Ronnie, but Ronnie plays coy. He downplays his role as just someone who took the lunch orders, but emphasizes that Phase 2 was "very important" to the experiment. Norm cedes authority to Ronnie to lead the way. ===[[The Wrangler]]=== Ronnie leads the Vault 31ers to the ruins of the Vault-Tec headquarters in Los Angeles. He works with another dweller to remove the wooden boards blocking the door and then walks into the lobby, where he is unfazed by the remains of his former coworkers and even callously makes fun of the dead receptionist, [[Janice (TV series)|Janice]], whose remains are still at the front desk where she worked. However, he is still shocked when something suddenly bangs on the door of the nearby elevator, though the group is interrupted by [[Ma June]] and [[Barv]] before anything else can happen. While Norm is off talking to Ma June further inside, Ronnie, Claudia, and another dweller sit on a couch next to the elevators, across from Barv, and Ronnie listens to Barv explain that they are using the elevator as a pen for [[Radroach (TV series)|radroaches]]. After Ma June and Barv leave, Ronnie takes the group further into the building to carry out his plans of contacting the Vault investors for Phase 2. Entering a communications room, he takes point, giving orders to Clark and Pete. He seems briefly suspicious of Norm when he realizes that Norm does not know who they are trying to contact, but he then continues instructing Clark and Pete to repair the radio system. Soon after, Claudia leads Norm to [[Barb Howard]]'s former office, where he hacks into Barb's terminal. Claudia, feeling intrigued by Norm, reveals that she knows he was lying about being Bud's successor, and that he killed Bud. Unbeknownst to either of them, Ronnie secretly followed them and is eavesdropping outside the office. After Claudia leaves, Ronnie enters to confront Norm, pulling the plug on the terminal and using the power cable to threaten Norm for lying to them. Though Norm briefly holds Ronnie at bay using a lamp, Ronnie gets the upper hand and manages to choke Norm unconscious. ===[[The Handoff]]=== Ronnie has revealed the truth about Norm to the rest of the Vault 31ers. While Norm is tied up inside a room, Ronnie debates with Clark and Pete about what to do with him, now that he has proven himself "dangerous" and "untrustworthy" in their eyes. Ronnie proposes that they execute Norm for impersonating a member of Vault-Tec, as outlined in the Vault-Tec handbook; Clark and Pete agree with him. Finding that Norm has woken up, Ronnie orders Clark to knock him out again. Later, Claudia unties Norm and goes with him to the comms room, where he sends out a message. Ronnie and the other 31ers find them right after Norm finishes his message. ===[[The Strip]]=== McCurtry and the Vault 31ers drag Norm through the headquarters against Claudia's wishes. Ronnie claims that Norm will receive a fair trial, as befitting American justice, though he seems to have no intention of letting Norm live; when Claudia still protests, he denounces her as also not being one of them due to having joined Vault-Tec just a week before the Great War. As they pass through the elevator hallway, Claudia forcefully shoves aside the [[executive assistant]] holding Norm and tries to help Norm, but Ronnie pushes her away to stop her. This causes her body to hit the elevator button, opening the shaft, inadvertently releasing all of the radroaches trapped inside, who kill the executive assistant and start attacking the other 31ers. All of the 31ers run inside a break room on the far end of the office to take cover. After the last 31er gets inside, Norm is the only one still outside. Holding the door, Ronnie forcefully keeps Norm from entering the room, but by doing so, he is not able to close the door before the radroaches get inside and start attacking all of the 31ers. Ironically, Norm himself is safe, as all of the radroaches went inside the break room, and the door closed afterwards. Sometime later, Norm enters the room to find all of the executives seemingly dead except Claudia, though Ronnie is not seen. ==Appearances== Ronnie McCurtry appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202|12=204|13=205|15=207|16=208}} ==Gallery== FTV S2E4 Still 158.png FTV S2E7 Still 076.png|Ronnie with [[Clark (TV series)|Clark]] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 31 characters]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]] [[ru:Ронни Маккарти]]
